machine_type.description: The emulated machine type (e.g., pc, q35, virt). See -machine type in man page.

accelerator.description: The virtualization accelerator (kvm, xen, hvf, tcg). See -accel in man page.

cpus.description: Number of virtual CPUs. See -smp cpus in man page.

memory_mb.description: Guest RAM size in megabytes. See -m size in man page.

boot_order.description: Boot order string of drive letters (e.g., c for hard disk, n for network). See -boot order in man page.

disk_image_path.description: Path to the disk image file. See -drive file in man page.

disk_format.description: Disk image format (raw, qcow2, vmdk, etc.). See -drive format in man page.

disk_cache.description: Disk cache mode (none, writeback, writethrough, unsafe, directsync). See -drive cache in man page.

network_backend.description: Network backend type (user, tap, bridge, socket). See -netdev type in man page.

network_mac.description: MAC address for the network interface. See -device mac= in man page.

network_model.description: Network device model (e1000, virtio-net-pci, rtl8139, etc.). See -device driver= in man page.

vnc_display.description: VNC display number (e.g., 0 for port 5900) or 'none' to disable. See -vnc display in man page.

guest_display_type.description: Guest display type (sdl, gtk, vnc, spice, none). See -display type in man page.

serial_console.description: Serial console device (vc, pty, stdio, none). See -serial dev in man page.

kernel_path.description: Path to the kernel image for direct boot. See -kernel in man page.

kernel_cmdline.description: Kernel command line arguments. See -append in man page.

enable_kvm.description: Enable KVM full virtualization support. See -enable-kvm in man page.

pause_on_start.description: Do not start CPU at startup. See -S in man page.

daemonize.description: Daemonize the QEMU process after initialization. See -daemonize in man page.

name.description: Name of the guest. See -name name in man page.
